heath:1897.author: Archimedes of Syracuse (ed. & trans. T. L. Heath)
heath:1897.work: The Works of Archimedes, edited in modern notation with introductory chapters
heath:1897.locus: Cambridge: At the University Press, 1897 (clxxxvi + 326 pp.)
heath:1897.note: Primary public-domain English edition covering Sphere and Cylinder I–II, Measurement of a Circle, Conoids and Spheroids, On Spirals, Equilibrium of Planes I–II, The Sand-Reckoner, Quadrature of the Parabola, On Floating Bodies I–II, Book of Lemmas, and the Cattle Problem.

heath:works-of-archimedes.author: Archimedes of Syracuse (ed. & trans. T. L. Heath)
heath:works-of-archimedes.note: Cross-corpus canonical citation key matching geometor/euclid.

heath:1912.author: Archimedes of Syracuse (ed. & trans. T. L. Heath)
heath:1912.work: The Method of Archimedes, Recently Discovered by Heiberg: A Supplement to The Works of Archimedes, 1897
heath:1912.locus: Cambridge: At the University Press, 1912 (51 pp.)
heath:1912.note: Public-domain Cambridge supplement translating Archimedes' Palimpsest treatise On Mechanical Theorems Addressed to Eratosthenes (Ephodos) from Heiberg's 1907 Greek transcription.

heath:method-of-archimedes.author: Archimedes of Syracuse (ed. & trans. T. L. Heath)
heath:method-of-archimedes.work: The Method of Archimedes, Recently Discovered by Heiberg
heath:method-of-archimedes.note: Cross-corpus canonical citation key matching geometor/euclid.

heiberg:1880.author: Archimedes of Syracuse (ed. Johan Ludvig Heiberg)
heiberg:1880.work: Archimedis Opera Omnia cum commentariis Eutocii, Vol. I
heiberg:1880.locus: Leipzig: B. G. Teubner, 1880 (2nd rev. ed. 1910)
heiberg:1880.note: Critical Teubner Greek text of De Sphaera et Cylindro I–II, Dimensio Circuli, and De Conoidibus et Sphaeroidibus.

heiberg:1881.author: Archimedes of Syracuse (ed. Johan Ludvig Heiberg)
heiberg:1881.work: Archimedis Opera Omnia cum commentariis Eutocii, Vol. II
heiberg:1881.locus: Leipzig: B. G. Teubner, 1881 (2nd rev. ed. 1913)
heiberg:1881.note: Critical Teubner text of De Lineis Spiralibus, De Planorum Aequilibriis I–II, Arenarius, Quadratura Parabolae, De Corporibus Fluitantibus, Stomachion, Ephodos (Methodus, added in 1913 2nd ed., pp. 425–507), and Liber Assumptorum (pp. 426–445 / 510–525).

heiberg:archimedis-opera.author: Archimedes of Syracuse (ed. Johan Ludvig Heiberg)
heiberg:archimedis-opera.work: Archimedis Opera Omnia cum commentariis Eutocii (Vols. I–III)
heiberg:archimedis-opera.note: Cross-corpus canonical Teubner citation key matching geometor/euclid.

heiberg:1907.author: Johan Ludvig Heiberg
heiberg:1907.locus: Hermes: Zeitschrift für classische Philologie 42 (1907), pp. 235–303
heiberg:1907.note: Editio princeps of the Greek text of Archimedes' Method deciphered from the 10th-century Constantinople Palimpsest (Codex C) in 1906.

venatorius:1544.author: Thomas Gechauff Venatorius (ed.)
venatorius:1544.work: Ἀρχιμήδους τοῦ Συρακουσίου τὰ μέχρι νῦν σωζόμενα ἅπαντα (Archimedis Syracusani Philosophi ac Geometrae Excellentissimi Opera, Editio Princeps)
venatorius:1544.note: First printed Greek and Latin edition of Archimedes and Eutocius's commentaries.

ecchellensis-borelli:1661.author: Abraham Ecchellensis & Giovanni Alfonso Borelli (eds.)
ecchellensis-borelli:1661.work: Archimedis Liber Assumptorum, interprete Thebit Ben-Kora exponente Almochtasso
ecchellensis-borelli:1661.locus: Florence: Ex Typographia Stellae, 1661 (appended to Apollonii Pergaei Conicorum Lib. V–VII)
ecchellensis-borelli:1661.note: First Latin edition of Archimedes' fifteen Lemmas translated from Thābit ibn Qurra's Arabic version.

archimedes:sphere-and-cylinder.author: Archimedes of Syracuse
archimedes:sphere-and-cylinder.work: On the Sphere and Cylinder (Περὶ σφαίρας καὶ κυλίνδρου, Books I–II)
archimedes:sphere-and-cylinder.note: Establishes convexity assumptions, Archimedes' Lemma, and the 2:3 sphere-to-cylinder volume and surface theorem.

archimedes:sphere-and-cylinder:ii-2.author: Archimedes of Syracuse
archimedes:sphere-and-cylinder:ii-2.work: On the Sphere and Cylinder, Book II, Prop. 2
archimedes:sphere-and-cylinder:ii-2.note: Cubature of any spherical segment reduced to an equivalent cone.

archimedes:conoids-and-spheroids.author: Archimedes of Syracuse
archimedes:conoids-and-spheroids.work: On Conoids and Spheroids (Περὶ κωνοειδέων καὶ σφαιροειδέων)
archimedes:conoids-and-spheroids.note: Quadrature of the ellipse and cubature of paraboloids, hyperboloids, and ellipsoids of revolution.

archimedes:equilibrium-of-planes:i-7.author: Archimedes of Syracuse
archimedes:equilibrium-of-planes:i-7.work: On the Equilibrium of Planes (Ἐπιπέδων ἰσορροπιῶν), Book I, Prop. 7
archimedes:equilibrium-of-planes:i-7.note: Proof of the Law of the Lever for incommensurable magnitudes via Eudoxean approximation.

archimedes:quadrature-of-parabola.author: Archimedes of Syracuse
archimedes:quadrature-of-parabola.note: Dual mechanical (Props. 1–17) and geometric exhaustion (Props. 18–24) proof that a parabolic segment equals 4/3 of its inscribed triangle.

archimedes:liber-assumptorum.author: Archimedes of Syracuse (tr. Thābit ibn Qurra)
archimedes:liber-assumptorum.work: Book of Lemmas (Liber Assumptorum / Kitāb al-Maʾkhūdhāt)
archimedes:liber-assumptorum.note: Fifteen planar lemmas preserving the Arbelos, Twin Circles, Neusis Trisection, Salinon, and golden-ratio pentagon/decagon secants.

archimedes:methodus.author: Archimedes of Syracuse
archimedes:methodus.work: The Method of Mechanical Theorems Addressed to Eratosthenes (Ἔφοδος)
archimedes:methodus.note: Palimpsest treatise unveiling Archimedes' analytic mechanical slice method and proving the cubature of the cylindrical ungula and bicylinder.

euclid:elements.author: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid:elements.note: Axiomatic foundation presupposed throughout Archimedes' canon: especially I.47 (Pythagoras), III.31 & III.35 (chords & semicircles in Arbelos/Salinon), V.Def.4 (Eudoxean ratio), VI.3 (angle bisector in Measurement Prop. 3), X.1 (exhaustion lemma), and XII.2, 7, 10, 18 (circles, pyramids, cones, spheres).

eutocius:in-archimedem.author: Eutocius of Ascalon
eutocius:in-archimedem.work: Commentarii in libros De Sphaera et Cylindro, In Dimensionem Circuli, In libros De Planorum Aequilibriis
eutocius:in-archimedem.note: Sole ancient Greek commentary on Archimedes: supplies explicit numerical multiplications for Measurement Prop. 3, preserves Archimedes' lost cubic-section lemma for Sphere and Cylinder II.4, and records twelve classical solutions to two mean proportionals.

pappus:synagoge:iv.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:synagoge:iv.note: Preserves the 'ancient proposition' on the infinite chain of tangent circles in the Arbelos (cn = n·dn), studies the Archimedean spiral, and classifies solid vs. neusis angle trisections.

pappus:synagoge:v.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:synagoge:v.note: Primary ancient witness recording the exact face counts and polygon species of all thirteen Semi-Regular Solids discovered by Archimedes.

pappus:synagoge:viii.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:synagoge:viii.note: Extends Archimedes' theory of centers of gravity (κέντρα βαρῶν) and leads directly to the Pappus–Guldin centroid theorem.

heron:metrica.author: Heron of Alexandria
heron:metrica.note: Explicitly quotes Archimedes' Measurement of a Circle, Sphere and Cylinder, Equilibrium, and The Method (ungula and bicylinder).

proclus:in-euclidem.author: Proclus Diadochus
proclus:in-euclidem.work: Commentary on the First Book of Euclid's Elements
proclus:in-euclidem.note: Cites Archimedes' postulate that the straight line is the shortest of lines having the same extremities (Friedlein 110) and Hiero's crown/ship narratives (Friedlein 63).

geometor:euclid.author: Sir Thomas Little Heath / GEOMETOR
geometor:euclid.work: GEOMETOR • euclid & elements: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
geometor:euclid.note: Sister Digital Scriptorium edition of Heath's Euclid and computable G-Index dependency DAG.

geometor:etc.author: Clark Kimberling / GEOMETOR
geometor:etc.work: GEOMETOR • etc: Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers
geometor:etc.note: Archimedes' On the Equilibrium of Planes I.13–14 provides the foundational synthetic proof of X(2) (intersection of medians) and homogeneous barycentric coordinates (1 : 1 : 1).

geometor:pacioli.author: Luca Pacioli / GEOMETOR
geometor:pacioli.note: Renaissance reconstruction of the truncated and semi-regular Archimedean polyhedra illustrated by Leonardo da Vinci.

geometor:pappus.author: Pappus of Alexandria / GEOMETOR
geometor:pappus.work: GEOMETOR • pappus: Projective & Classical Configurations from the Synagoge
geometor:pappus.note: Companion constructive repository linking Pappus's Collection (harmonic conjugates, circle chains, and semi-regular polyhedra) to Archimedes.

geometor:wildberger.author: N. J. Wildberger / GEOMETOR
geometor:wildberger.work: GEOMETOR • wildberger: Divine Proportions & Rational Trigonometry
geometor:wildberger.locus: Archimedes' Function / Quadrea A(Q1, Q2, Q3) (geometor/wildberger)
geometor:wildberger.note: Formalizes Archimedes' algebraic invariant A(Q1, Q2, Q3) = (Q1 + Q2 + Q3)^2 - 2(Q1^2 + Q2^2 + Q3^2) = 16·Area^2 governing collinearity, Heron/Archimedes triangle area, and rational circle tangency.

hilbert:1899.author: David Hilbert / GEOMETOR
hilbert:1899.locus: Axiom Group V: Axiom of Continuity / Archimedes' Axiom (geometor/hilbert)
hilbert:1899.note: Elevates Archimedes' Lemma (Sphere and Cylinder I Assump. 5) into Axiom V 1 of modern axiomatic geometry and demonstrates non-Archimedean ordered fields.
